title: Pandolfi's teenage metallurgical analysis of a Glomar Explorer piece

tellings.quote: >> Well, that's that's another story. The story was that his father gave him a piece that he was they were involved with the uh uh Glowar Explorer.

plain: Ron Pandolfi is said to have studied, as a teenager, the metal of a piece his father gave him, which came from the work of the Glomar Explorer, a deep-sea recovery ship his father was involved with. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron repeats this as a story Pandolfi told, and calls it "another story" in passing. If true, an odd piece from a secret recovery would have passed through a family's hands.
